options.name: append
options.description: Merge the provided facts into the existing cached facts. If set to C(false), the provided facts replace the existing facts.

options.name: facts
options.description: Dictionary containing the fact payload. This value is written to the generated local fact file when O(state=present).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the fact file without the C(.fact) suffix.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the named local fact. Use C(present) to create or update the fact. Use C(absent) to remove the fact and its cache files.
